items.headline: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft

items.headline: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning

items.headline: iPhone Handoff will seamlessly share one number between two phones
items.detail: When iOS 27 lands later this month, it will have a feature called iPhone Handoff that lets you switch between two phones using the same number.

items.headline: We got more defensive last week as Wall Street raised the bar for AI stocks
